name: 2879-longprompt-7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, 32 query heads and 32 KV heads (no GQA), head_dim 128, hidden 4096, intermediate 11008, fp16, 6.74B params (~12.6 GiB), context window 4096.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 500 requests with a 1800 s safety cap, static seed 2879.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`, 2048 prompt tokens in and 256 tokens out, one turn, min == max on both lengths, no shared prefix, prompt sent as-is with no chat template (`request_format: "plain"`).
purpose: A summarization service on a 7B chat model condensing long reports for 32 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# vLLM 0.3.3-era (checkout 8fa7357f2d31) AsyncEngineArgs: an unknown key is a TypeError at
# engine construction. Do not add flags from a later vLLM.
model: meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-chat-hf
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: float16
max-model-len: 4096
enable-prefix-caching: false
block-size: 16
